preserved_failures.failure: The first source implementation divided error.square().mean() by 64 a second time and used matching 64^2 denominators in the causal native normal equations.
preserved_failures.effect: The registered 0.05 Euclidean floor was 64 times too small.
preserved_failures.correction: Use mean_t ||e_t||^2 / 64 = error.square().mean(), 0.05/64 in the intercept metric, and n*64 in native floor statistics.

preserved_failures.failure: Causal affine minibatches recomputed mean ||g||^2 per minibatch.
preserved_failures.effect: The optimizer minimized an average of batchwise ratios rather than the registered global fit ratio.
preserved_failures.correction: Freeze mean ||g||^2 from all clipped compiler_fit adjoints and use that scalar in every minibatch and full-fit evaluation.

preserved_failures.failure: The first native-causal source held the zero-gate optimal intercept fixed while fitting gates.
preserved_failures.effect: Gate features and the intercept are coupled under the row-dependent Fisher metric, so E did not minimize its registered objective.
preserved_failures.correction: Form the joint gate/intercept quadratic, eliminate the 64-vector intercept by its exact Schur complement, refit supports in the reduced gate system, and serialize the conditional intercept for the chosen amplitudes.

determinism_clarification: Reset the seeded minibatch generator for every C lambda/rank candidate so candidate trajectories are invariant to enumeration order.
scope: Pre-outcome solver correction only. It changes no preregistered loss, row, split, family, grid, selection rule, threshold, or final gate; it makes the implementation equal the already-registered objective.
